Why Choose Hausen

Engineered for Excellence

01
Super Heavy Grade

At 5mm thick and 23 Kg per box, our panels are significantly heavier and more substantial than standard PVC panels — built to last.

02
Moisture Resistant

100% waterproof core means ideal performance in bathrooms, kitchens, and any high-humidity space without warping or swelling.

03
Easy Installation

Each panel at 3050mm × 254mm covers 8.33 sq ft. Simple click-fit installation means walls transform without mess or disruption.

04
Premium Finishes

15 distinctive designs — from natural wood grains to dramatic marble, ornate patterns and abstract textures to suit every style.
